after.identity_note: Uncommitted body-facts implementation; exact hashes identify measured sources.

fixture.digest_format: generation-order u64be path-length/path/u64be byte-length/bytes; excludes manifest

method.timed: Permission resolution, shared query service, compact JSON serialization.
method.excluded: Cargo compilation, process/test startup, request file parsing, independent result oracle, diagnostic printing, external fixture digest validation.
method.oracle: Exact total and ordered paths; at most 50 rows, no body, empty diagnostics, serialized output <=256KiB.
method.cache: Same schema-22 cache. First unrestricted request after changing model refreshes derived rows. First requests retained separately; all repeated requests use one cache hit and no refresh or fallback.
method.quantiles: Nearest rank; median arithmetic middle pair; first request excluded from repeated summaries.
method.fixture_verified: Full source payload digest and membership matched before baseline, after release build, and after final run.
method.identities_verified: Both executable hashes and all eight implementation hashes unchanged after runs.
method.overlap: All eight timing runs serialized without concurrent Cargo jobs, fixture verification or other benchmark runs.

limitations: Development-host diagnostic, not designated-reference acceptance; power/frequency/background activity uncontrolled and OS pages warmed by fixture verification.
Only 18 repeated varied requests per build/scope. No 1000-sample, concurrency, memory growth, 100K, cold-cache, write or rebuild acceptance evidence.
First requests after model switches include refresh; do not compare them as warm queries.
Nested stage durations overlap their parents. Counters do not cover every syscall or compilation.

Parsing is removed from cached overlays, but all visible bodies still hydrate, all link targets still resolve, full CEL input bindings still materialize and two source manifests still hash all visible files.
Larger local payloads increase measured SQLite/decode cost. The end-to-end improvement is smaller than the overlay-stage reduction.
No target is passed or declared unreachable by these diagnostic measurements.
